changes_after_seeing_data: B1 (before any probe or CI, listed in seen_before): the cap by its cone from the pinhole and each cap's line bounded by its ball replaced the 1.5 px gating by the ball.

The probe's sensing arm (the whole tests/sensing at -n 4) failed two tests: G7 in float64 (6.1e-13 against its derived line 2.6e-13) was the oracle's own rounding (b^2 - a c cancels about a thousandfold in float64); the oracle now runs in extended precision and the test checks that premise: 1.2e-13 (float32 unchanged, 3.9e-5). The display opacity's refusal wrote a quoted name with a possessive, which the refusal's text writes plain, so the test's quoted name never matched; it now names its subject and has its own remedy.
The hull oracle clips each row's strip first (10 to 27 times faster; areas equal to 5e-11), before the probe.

The probe's arms were packed nine (the launcher estimated each arm in the heavy slot's queue); the cache walk's plants ran five times each (a deterministic walk), the flags' and G6's per node (15 and 10 runs a node).
M5's prediction guessed the disc's cost came with a3e937b; it came with the PR's first code commit (the float32-stable integral), measured against the first step's arithmetic on this head.
